senses.gloss: m. (v. קָלִיל) a vessel, esp. the pitcher containing the ashes of the red cow.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Parah 3:3">Par. III, 3</cite>; <cite ref="Mishnah Parah 10:3">X, 3</cite> <he>ק׳ של חטאת</he> the vessel containing the ashes for lustration; <cite ref="Tosefta Parah 9:5">Tosef. ib. IX</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Parah 10:5">X</cite>), 5; a. e.—Pl. <he>קְלָלוֹת</he>.

<cite ref="Tosefta Parah 3:4">Tosef. ib. III</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Parah 2:4">II</cite>), 4 <he>קְלִילִיּוֹת</he> (Var. <cite ref="S01267"><he>קלולי</he></cite>; R. S. to <cite ref="Mishnah Parah 3:3">Par. III, 3</cite> <cite ref="S00963"><he>קילולות</he></cite>, corr. acc.).
